The product

One platform, every workflow — not fifteen disconnected tools

Most schools run on a patchwork: one system for fees, a register for attendance, spreadsheets for marks, and WhatsApp for parents. NIKSHA OS replaces that patchwork with a single record of the school, where every module reads the same truth.

Mobile-first, genuinely

Teachers mark attendance and enter marks from a phone, standing in a classroom. Parents get results and notices on the device they already carry. Not a desktop product with a phone view bolted on.

Built around roles, not menus

A principal, a class teacher, an accountant and a parent open the same app and see four different workspaces — each showing only the tasks that person is responsible for, and only the data they are permitted to see.

Made for Indian schools

State-board and CBSE grading, FA/SA assessment cycles, term fee schedules, transport routes, hostel allocation and TC no-dues clearance — modelled as they are actually run, not adapted from a foreign template.

Modules

Everything a school runs on

Each module is a complete workflow, not a data-entry form. Schools switch on only what they need.

Admissions

Enquiry through to enrolment: capture leads, track follow-ups, and convert an applicant into a student record without re-typing anything.

Attendance

Daily marking in seconds. Corrections route through an approval so the register stays auditable — you can always see who changed what, and why.

Examinations & results

Marks entry, FA/SA cycles, board grading, results and ranks. Absent, medical and debarred are recorded honestly — never silently as a zero that drags an average down.

Fees & finance

Invoices, collections and receipts against one student account per year. Concessions require two-person approval before anything payable is reduced.

Transport

Routes, stops and stage-wise transport fees, raised as a demand against the student's existing fee account rather than a separate ledger to reconcile.

Hostel

Room and bed allocation, occupancy at a glance, and hostel charges that flow into the same finance loop as every other fee.

Library

Catalogue, issue and return, overdue tracking, and digital resources shared to specific classes.

HR & staff

Staff records, leave and payroll inputs. Staff attendance is verified by live camera and geofence — not a PIN that can be shared.

Parent communication

Announcements, fee reminders, attendance alerts and results delivered to the parent's phone, with a record of what was sent and to whom.

Insight & AI copilot Read-only

Leadership dashboards computed deterministically from your own data — the same number, every time you ask. The AI copilot explains and summarises what it finds, and is architecturally prevented from writing to your records. It answers questions; it never changes marks, money or attendance.

Privacy & data protection

Children's data, handled the way it should be

A school platform holds some of the most sensitive data there is. NIKSHA OS is written to India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, and the DPDP Rules, 2025.

We never sell data, and never advertise to children

No behavioural advertising, no data brokerage, no third-party trackers on student records.

Your school owns its records

The Institution is the Data Fiduciary. NIKSHA OS acts as a Data Processor, handling data only on the school's documented instructions.

Access is enforced, not assumed

Every request is checked against the user's role and school. A parent can reach their own children's records and nothing else — enforced in the database, not just the UI.

Changes leave a trail

Money, marks and attendance corrections are recorded with who made them and when, so a school can always reconstruct what happened.
